stories.title: Create reusable footer component
stories.acceptance_criteria: tythe_time_tracker/ui/components/footer.py exists with render_footer() function. Function renders 'Powered by Kari Suite' via st.markdown with styled HTML (subtle, muted, centered, small font, hr separator above).

stories.title: Add footer to all pages
stories.acceptance_criteria: render_footer() is called at the bottom of employee_interface.py, personal_timesheet.py, export_interface.py, and manager_dashboard.py. Footer appears after all page content on every page.

stories.title: Login page branding
stories.acceptance_criteria: Login page displays prominent 'Powered by Kari Suite' branding (larger than footer, centered, below login form). App title and Kari Suite branding shown together in a cohesive branded layout.
